|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Wild Karrde (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-wildkarrde-2020-05-12.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-L-wildkarrde-2020-05-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-L-wildkarrde-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V3-L-wildkarrde-2020-05-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-L-wildkarrde-2020-05-12.gif]], 12 May 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[Wild Karrde]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-wildkarrde022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/wildkarrde.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/wildkarrde.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Medium Bulk Freighter”. Text: “May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, your total battle destiny is +1 for each smuggler aboard. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-wildkarrdea5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/wildkarrde.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/wildkarrde.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
